negative_snippets:
Visited this place for brunch and ordered a tandoori paratha, but the experience was very disappointing. The paratha barely had any stuffing inside, it was almost empty. When we pointed it out and asked them to remake it, they served another one exactly the same way, still with almost no stuffing.

On top of that, the staff serving us were quite unprofessional and didn’t seem concerned about the issue at all. They were like our guests prefer it this way and we have make lakhs of parathas.
